verses.t: … “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye mālāgandhavilepanadhāraṇamaṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā; atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye mālāgandhavilepanadhāraṇamaṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānā appaṭiviratā …pe…. Dasamaṁ. Dutiyaāmakadhaññapeyyālavaggo aṭṭhamo.
Pāṇaṁ adinnaṁ kāmesu, musāvādañca pesuññaṁ; Pharusaṁ samphappalāpaṁ, bījañca vikālaṁ gandhanti.
